'''2020 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on GEMP. [[Justin Desai]] defeated [[Paul Myers]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-online-championship-series-registration-opens/. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022095952/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2022-online-championship-series-registration-opens.html Internet Archive]</ref> The 2020 Online Championship Series, the third year of the series, ran for nine and a half months with almost 2,500 games; its finals ended on 10 November 2020.<ref name="dc-775804305680367636">"After 9.5 months & almost 2500 games, this year's Online Championship Series", JaredNap in #ocs-discussion, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (10 November 2020). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/749413518431748107/775804305680367636 Discord message]</ref>
